text:
[Council File 14-0185-S1; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF HARBOR COMMISSIONERS relative to the First Amendment and Order Resetting Compensation under Permit No. 900 with Wallenius Wilhelmsen Logistics (WWL) Vehicle Services America, Inc. concerning the use and occupancy of Harbor Department property located at Berths 195-200A.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. ADOPT the determination by the Board of Harbor Commissioners that the proposed action is categorically exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article III Classes 1(14) and 1(18)(d) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE POLA Resolution No. 26-10789 for the First Amendment and Order resetting compensation under Permit No. 900 with WWL Vehicle Services Americas, Inc
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Administrative Officer reports that there is no impact on the City’s General Fund. The net financial impact of suspending the CPI increase for the calendar year 2026 is $290,810. However, under the five-year term extension from January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2031, the Harbor Department expects to receive a minimum of $104.2 million in compensation assuming five years of compensation at the 2026 MAG rate of $20.8 million. Revenues will be deposited in the Harbor Revenue Fund. The recommendations in this report and proposed actions comply with the Department’s Financial Policies.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Trade, Travel, and Tourism Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
TIME LIMIT FILE - OCTOBER 30, 2026

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted, Forthwith (Oct 30, 2026); Council action final
